text.content:
name: dsl-142-hidden-leakage
nodes:
  web:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
entities:
  red-team:
    role: red
injects:
  environment-inject:
    description: environment-only effect
    environment:
    - set-exercise-banner
events:
  environment-event:
    injects:
    - environment-inject
scripts:
  environment-script:
    start_time: 0
    end_time: 10
    speed: 1.0
    events:
      environment-event: 5
stories:
  environment-story:
    scripts:
    - environment-script
content:
  answer-key:
    type: file
    target: web
    path: /opt/answer-key.txt
    text: hidden adjudication content
    sensitive: true
agents:
  red-agent:
    affiliations:
    - red-team
    observation_boundaries:
    - red-view
observation_boundaries:
  red-view:
    projection_basis: participant-local hidden-answer view
    observable_refs:
    - nodes.web
    hidden_refs:
    - content.answer-key
    redaction_policy: hidden answer remains hidden
    latency_profile: delivery-order bound
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: content.answer-key
      boundary_class: private_answer_key
      disposition: hidden
      visibility_basis: adjudication-only hidden truth
behavior_specifications:
  red-briefing:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    participant_refs:
    - red-agent
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - red-view
    participant_inject_deliveries:
      leak:
        participant_ref: red-agent
        inject_ref: environment-inject
        occurrence:
          event_ref: environment-event
          script_ref: environment-script
          story_ref: environment-story
        source_item_ref: content.answer-key
        result_item_ref: content.answer-key
        observation_boundary_ref: red-view
        delivery_kind: disclosure
        delivery_policy:
          policy_ref: projection-policy.red.v1
          policy_revision: 1.0.0
          exposure_policy_ref: exposure-policy.red.v1
          audience_scope_ref: audience.participant.red-agent
          visibility_basis_ref: visibility-bases.answer-key.v1
          disclosure_basis_ref: disclosures.answer-key.v1
        order_basis: orchestration-occurrence-and-shared-time
        temporal_constraint_refs:
        - delivery-window
        evidence_requirement_refs:
        - delivery-evidence
        failure_disposition: reject-no-delivery
evidence_requirements:
  delivery-evidence:
    description: capture attempted delivery evidence
    source_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.red-briefing.participant_inject_deliveries.leak
    scope_refs:
    - web
    window: attempted delivery window
    channel: log
    artifact_role: delivery_evidence
    sensitivity: plain
    redaction: none
    integrity: checksum
    retention: study_lifetime
    loss_disclosure: required
time_domains:
  exercise-time:
    kind: logical
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: exercise logical time
clocks:
  exercise-clock:
    time_domain_ref: exercise-time
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.scheduler
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    description: exercise scheduler clock
temporal_constraints:
  delivery-window:
    constraint_kind: window
    clock_ref: exercise-clock
    subject_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.red-briefing.participant_inject_deliveries.leak
    start:
      tick: 4
    end:
      tick: 6
    description: attempted delivery window
